title: picardCoefficientTranspose_pasting
statement: Schemes and module sheaves are as in [def-pc-scheme] and [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], with the shared derived categories [def-pc-derived-category]. Fix $f:X\to S$, an $\mathcal O_X$-module $L$, and $k:W\to S$. Put $M=q_W^\otimes L$ and $E=Rp_{W*}(M[0])$. For $r:V\to W$, let $a_r:X\times_S V\to X\times_S W$ be the projection lift, $N_r=q_V^\otimes L$, and $d_r:a_r^*M\cong N_r$ the ordinary-to-tensor adjunction comparison followed by the inverse conjugate of pushforward composition [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. Let $B_r: Lr^*E\to Rp_{V*}(N_r[0])$ be canonical base change [def-pc-derived-base-change-map] followed by direct image of $s_{a_r}(M)$ and $d_r[0]$, where $s$ is [lem-pc-canonical-single-pullback-comparison]. Write $\tau_r:Lp_V^*Lr^*E\to N_r[0]$ for its pinned derived-adjunction transpose [lem-pc-scheme-derived-mate-evaluation]. Given $i:T'\to T$, $t:T\to W$, $t':T'\to W$ with $it=t'$, and $j:X\times_S T'\to X\times_S T$ satisfying $jq_T=q_{T'}$ and $jp_T=p_{T'}i$, let $C:Li^*Lt^*\cong Lt'^*$ and $D: Lp_{T'}^*Li^*\cong Lj^*Lp_T^*$ be the canonical derived comparisons [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition], and let $d:j^*N_t\cong N_{t'}$ be the analogous coefficient comparison. Then, in Lean composition order, $D_{Lt^*E}\gg Lj^*(\tau_t)\gg s_j(N_t)\gg d[0]=Lp_{T'}^*(C_E)\gg\tau_{t'}$. No test section or structure-sheaf source normalization occurs, and no coefficient comparison $s_j$ is assumed invertible. The displayed construction is named in [def-sc-picard-coefficient-transpose].

Their proved defining equations identify them with the original displayed maps. The counit presentation is equal to the original fixed base-change mate by coefficientMate_evaluation in the forced factorization adaptation. Only the definitions change presentation; the morphism is unchanged.
The two projection equations and pullback.hom_ext show j followed by a equals aprime. Apply canonicalDerivedSquareComparison_vertical to these two commuting squares.

The typed tensorSingleCoefficientMap_composition API is proved from tensorSinglePullback_composition. In the same module, the generic coefficientCounitTranspose_pasting API combines it with square coherence and naturality of the derived composition comparison on the counit. Apply that API to the canonical fibre-product lifts. This checks coherence on arbitrary schemes before specialization, while retaining the entire pasting proof in this file.

theorem picardCoefficientTranspose_pasting
    {X S : Scheme.{v}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    (L : X.Modules) (W : Scheme.{v}) (k : W ⟶ S)
    {T T' : Scheme.{v}} (i : T' ⟶ T) (t : T ⟶ W) (t' : T' ⟶ W)
    (h : i ≫ t = t')
    (j : pullback f (t' ≫ k) ⟶ pullback f (t ≫ k))
    (hj₁ : j ≫ pullback.fst f (t ≫ k) = pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k))
    (hj₂ : j ≫ pullback.snd f (t ≫ k) = pullback.snd f (t' ≫ k) ≫ i)
 :
  let τ : ∀ {V : Scheme.{v}} (r : V ⟶ W),
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd f (r ≫ k))).obj
      ((derivedPullback r).obj
        ((schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
            (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
              ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L)))) ⟶
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f (r ≫ k)).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
          ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (r ≫ k))).obj L) :=
    picardCoefficientTranspose f L W k
  let E := (schemeDerivedDirectImage (pullback.snd f k)).obj
    ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f k).toRingedSpace)) 0).obj
        ((Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f k)).obj L))
  let C := canonicalDerivedPullbackComposition i t ≪≫
    eqToIso (congrArg (fun q : T' ⟶ W ↦ derivedPullback q) h)
  let N := (Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k))).obj L
  let c := (conjugateIsoEquiv
    ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
      (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)))).comp
        (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)))
    (Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction
      (pullback.fst f (t' ≫ k))))).symm
    (Modules.pushforwardComp j (pullback.fst f (t ≫ k)) ≪≫
      Modules.pushforwardCongr hj₁)
  let d := ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction j)).leftAdjointUniq
    (Modules.pullbackPushforwardAdjunction j)).symm.app N ≪≫ (c.app L).symm
  canonicalDerivedSquareComparison (pullback.snd f (t ≫ k))
      (pullback.snd f (t' ≫ k)) i j hj₂ ((derivedPullback t).obj E) ≫
    (derivedPullback j).map (τ t) ≫ Modules.canonicalSinglePullbackMap j N ≫
      (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
        (SheafOfModules.{v} (moduleRings (pullback f (t' ≫ k)).toRingedSpace)) 0).map
          d.hom =
    (derivedPullback (pullback.snd f (t' ≫ k))).map (C.hom.app E) ≫ τ t'
